manifest.source: existing engine status/trace only; no additional exchange polling
manifest.authorization: order false, prior trading session closed

sampling: local status ~4Hz, left-held intervals; durations are snapshot estimates, not proof of sub-sample continuity

request_rolling_window.scope: SDK GET starts observed by trace, including carry-in starts retained; other processes/SDK startup outside the recording are not measured

economics_assumptions: same-size two Lighter VWAP legs; opposite book shifts proportionally to prior-basis target with Binance/FX held fixed; full spread included once in VWAPs; no extra spread subtraction. Hypothetical reversion, fee model from metadata, exact fee NULL, 5bps configured uncertainty buffer. Not fill/PnL or measured latency.
